review.notes: Whole-document word-level diff of the OCR markdown against extracted text from all 14 physical PDF pages; physical p.1 was rendered in full (100 dpi) and the p.1/p.6/p.9/p.10 footnote strips at 300 dpi. Both algorithm code fences are balanced and preserve underscores and identifiers correctly. Remaining diff gaps are page-number stamps, the arXiv side stamp, figure-internal labels of the Figure 1 cascade diagram (covered by its embedded image), and text-layer artifacts (reference page-range spacing, diacritic decomposition).
